## Tired of Cloud Native Complexity?  
Take Back Control.

Cloud native isn’t one-size-fits-all. Whether you're modernizing legacy systems, scaling Kubernetes® environments, or driving AI-powered innovation, your journey is unique, and so are your roadblocks.

Nutanix simplifies what’s next. Our unified platform helps you run VMs, containers, and AI workloads anywhere. No silos. No replatforming. No complexity.

### Pick the challenge that’s holding you back, and see how to solve it.

1.  Unifying VMs and Containers On One Platform
2.  Running Kubernetes at Scale
3.  Deploying and Managing AI Like Other Workloads

## Unifying VMs and Containers On One Platform

Still managing VMs and containers on separate platforms? You’re not alone. Many organizations are embracing Kubernetes®, but siloed environments can drive up costs and slow innovation.

Nutanix brings both together on a single platform without silos or rework. Simplify operations and modernize with proven enterprise-grade virtualization, Kubernetes, and [data services](/products/data-services-for-kubernetes) with integrated disaster recovery, backup, and storage capabilities.

## Running Kubernetes at Scale

Running Kubernetes® across environments? It’s powerful, but can be painful. Fragmented tooling and inconsistent governance make it hard to scale and secure workloads.

Reduce the operational complexity of running cloud native applications at scale with a unified control plane to automate deployment, scaling, and monitoring. Nutanix delivers an enterprise-grade [Kubernetes platform](/products/kubernetes-management-platform) with centralized control, built-in resiliency, and complete Day-2 operations, on-premises, edge, and across clouds.

Manage fleets of clusters across clouds, datacenters, and the edge without complexity or vendor lock-in. Accelerate app development by enabling developers to focus on writing code and deploying fasterer, rather than struggling with the intricacies of Kubernetes infrastructure.

## Deploying and Managing AI Like Other Workloads

AI is accelerating, but complexity risks slowing teams down. Specialized infrastructure, siloed teams, manual workflows, and growing challenges in data and security can make scaling difficult. 

Nutanix enables enterprises to deploy and manage AI workloads like any other. With built-in Kubernetes®, GPU support, and hybrid cloud flexibility, combined with advanced storage and enterprise-grade data services, you can run AI anywhere.

## FAQs

### How can I simplify operations across VMs and containers?

Nutanix enables you to run both VMs and containers on a single, future-ready platform—eliminating silos, tackling overhead, and accelerating modernization. This unified approach helps IT teams streamline management and minimize complexity.

### What’s the best way to manage Kubernetes across hybrid and multicloud environments?

The [Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP)](/products/kubernetes-management-platform) solution offers centralized control, built-in resiliency, and Day-2 operations support—making it easy to deploy, govern, and scale Kubernetes® across on-prem, edge, and cloud environments.

### Can I run AI workloads on existing infrastructure?

Yes. Nutanix supports AI workloads using built-in Kubernetes, GPU acceleration, and hybrid cloud flexibility—allowing you to scale AI initiatives without rearchitecting your environment.
